arguments.manifest:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: node-shell
  namespace: shop
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: node-shell}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: node-shell}
    spec:
      hostNetwork: true
      containers:
      - name: shell
        image: busybox:1.36
        securityContext:
          privileged: true
